sculptures.title: Sri Kanyaka Parameshwari
sculptures.subject: Devi
sculptures.short_description: A standing goddess framed by a flowing prabhavali arch.
sculptures.description: The goddess stands in serene frontal posture beneath a foliate prabhavali crowned with a kirtimukha. A parrot rests on the lotus in her upper hand, while finely carved girdles, bells and pleated drapery fall in layered rhythm to the lotus pedestal.

sculptures.title: Anantha Narayana
sculptures.subject: Vishnu
sculptures.short_description: Vishnu seated in royal ease beneath the five-hooded Adishesha.
sculptures.description: Seated on the coils of Adishesha, Vishnu holds the chakra and shankha aloft while the serpent's five hoods open like a canopy above his crown. The granular stone gives the coils a living texture, contrasted with smooth limbs and crisp ornament.

sculptures.title: Varaha Avatar
sculptures.subject: Vishnu
sculptures.short_description: The boar avatar of Vishnu, carved in deep relief against a temple niche.
sculptures.description: Varaha strides forward with mace in hand, a garland sweeping across his body, the small seated figure of Bhudevi resting at his shoulder. The niche behind is worked with lotus petals and scrolling vines in the temple idiom.

sculptures.title: Radha Krishna beneath the Kadamba
sculptures.subject: Krishna
sculptures.short_description: An openwork panel where flute, foliage and birds intertwine.
sculptures.description: Krishna plays the flute as Radha leans in with a water pot, both standing on a double lotus base. Above them the kadamba tree dissolves into pierced, scrolling foliage alive with birds, a demanding feat of undercutting in a single panel.

about.title: About Us
about.intro: We bring devotion to life through finely crafted sculptures that celebrate India’s timeless spiritual heritage.
about.content:
Devalok Sculptures creates devotional and artistic sculptures in stone, wood, metal and marble. Our work draws on the temple traditions of India: the protective arch of the prabhavali, the poised stance of a standing deity, the joy of a dancing Ganapati.

Every piece is handcrafted by skilled artisans. We believe the time spent on a crown’s filigree or the folds of a garment is itself an act of devotion, and that a finished sculpture should feel present long before it is placed in a shrine.

seo.title: About Us
seo.description: We bring devotion to life through finely crafted sculptures that celebrate India’s timeless spiritual heritage.

sections.label: Value 1
sections.heading: Artistry
sections.description: Every form begins as a drawing of proportion and posture, refined until the figure feels alive in its stillness.

sections.label: Value 2
sections.heading: Craftsmanship
sections.description: Stone, wood, metal and marble are shaped by skilled hands, with the patience each material asks for.

sections.label: Value 3
sections.heading: Cultural Inspiration
sections.description: Our forms draw on India's temple traditions, from the ornate prabhavali arch to the grace of a dancing Ganapati.

sections.label: Value 4
sections.heading: Attention to Detail
sections.description: Crowns, jewellery, drapery and lotus bases are carved line by line, because devotion lives in the details.
